verdict.question: Is it ready for Poppy?

explain.not_set_up: That's normal: Poppy is brand new, and almost no site supports it yet.
explain.unreachable: Its Poppy file never answered, so the checker could not measure anything. The site may have been down or slow when it was checked.
explain.not_checked: Ora's own check failed, so nothing was measured. The problem was on Ora's side, not the site's. Check again to get a result.
explain.problems: This site has started setting up Poppy, but at least one must-fix or should-fix check failed.
explain.working: This site has a Poppy front door, and every must-fix and should-fix check the checker runs today passed.
explain.no_problems_found: Nothing serious failed. But this run couldn't measure some checks, so they are listed below.
explain.unknown: The checker gave a result this site can't show yet. The full report has every detail.

invitation.before: Is this your site? {domain} doesn't publish a Poppy file yet.

verdict.profileHelp: the Poppy version and check list used

fixFirst.question: What do I fix first?
fixFirst.intro: The failed checks that matter most, must-fix first. Each one links the setup step that fixes it.
fixFirst.none: Nothing. No must-fix or should-fix check failed.
fixFirst.noneMinorOne: Nothing urgent. No must-fix or should-fix check failed. The 1 check that failed is a minor one, listed in the full report.
fixFirst.noneMinorMany: Nothing urgent. No must-fix or should-fix check failed. The {n} checks that failed are minor ones, listed in the full report.
fixFirst.unreachable: First make sure {domain}/.well-known/poppy.json answers over HTTPS. Then check again.
fixFirst.notChecked: Nothing yet. Nothing was measured, so there is nothing to fix.

notChecked.question: What wasn't checked?
notChecked.intro: Today the checker runs the public file and safety checks. These other checks did not run.

unmeasured.title: Not measured on this run
unmeasured.intro: These must-fix and should-fix checks run today, but this run could not measure them.

2a.title: Coming soon
2a.intro: The checker doesn't run these yet.

2b.title: Owner checks (optional)
2b.intro: These run only when the site owner verifies the domain and turns them on.
2b.linkText: Verify you own the domain on Ora

3.title: Signed-in flows
3.intro: What an assistant can do once a person signs in. The checker doesn't run these yet.
